chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام used to say:
"How can ghusl (ritual bath) not be obligatory when the hadd is applicable in it?"
And he said: "The dowry and the ghusl become obligatory upon him."

key_terms.الْحَدُّ: the prescribed legal punishment in Islamic law
key_terms.الْغُسْلَ: ghusl; the ritual bath required after janabah
key_terms.الْمَهْرُ: the dowry owed in the marital legal context
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ: upon him; indicating legal liability or obligation

ai.seo_question: When does ghusl become obligatory according to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام states a legal ruling linking the obligation of ghusl (ritual bath) with a case in which the hadd ruling applies. It also affirms that the mahr and ghusl become obligatory, indicating legal consequences in matters of sexual relations.
